bio.text: Rick Bennett is an independent candidate for Governor of Maine in the November 3, 2026 general election and currently represents District 18 in the Maine Senate.
The Maine Legislature lists his legislative service as the 118th through 121st and 130th through 132nd Senates and the 115th and 116th Houses.
According to his campaign website, he grew up in Yarmouth and lives in Oxford, Maine.

He earned a B.A. from Harvard University in 1986 and an M.B.A. from the University of Southern Maine in 2000, and has been chief executive of GMI Ratings and chair of the Republican Party of Maine, which he left in 2025 to register as an independent.
